briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push capability frontier as multi-agent security gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 new models this month with rapid capability gains. Funding remains elevated at $11.9B quarterly while safety concerns mount over prompt injection in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic released Claude 4.5; DeepSeek-R2 and xAI Grok-3 closed the gap on coding benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and automotive CAN bus use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units; Microsoft and CoreWeave announced 200k H200 cluster expansions in Texas and Germany.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems outpace protocol-level defenses before 2027?
